results.question: What are the main ingredients of a Colombian ajiaco?
results.reply_text:
Main ingredients of a Colombian Ajiaco (Ajiaco Bogotano):

Chicken (usually whole or pieces)
Three varieties of potatoes:

Papa criolla (Criollo potato)
Papa pastusa (Pastusa potato)
Papa ropa vieja (Ropa Vieja potato)


Corn on the cob (elote)
Guascas (an aromatic herb native to the Andes, essential for the distinctive flavor)
Cilantro (or culantro)
Capers (for a salty contrast)
Avocado (served on the side to add creaminess)
Cream or crema (often added at the table)
White rice (served alongside)
Salt and pepper (to taste)

These components together create the hearty, comforting soup that is iconic in Bogotá and throughout Colombia.
Nya~
(Sources: My Colombian Recipes, Immigrant’s Table, Delish D'Lites, Cheeky Foods, BBC Travel – all confirming the same core ingredients.)
